# eFruitMandi

eFruitMandi is an online fruit trading platform by Orchard Growers Private Limited for connecting fruit growers, buyers, and logistics partners.

Website: https://www.efruitmandi.live
Company: Orchard Growers Private Limited
Focus: Fruit lots, fruit buyers, fruit growers, logistics, KYC verified trading, escrow-based payment flow.

## Important Pages

- Home: https://www.efruitmandi.live/
- Fruit Lots: https://www.efruitmandi.live/auctions
- Buyer Registration: https://www.efruitmandi.live/register-buyer
- Grower Registration: https://www.efruitmandi.live/register-grower
- Driver / Logistics Registration: https://www.efruitmandi.live/register-driver
- KYC Verification: https://www.efruitmandi.live/kyc
- Privacy Policy: https://www.efruitmandi.live/privacy-policy
- Terms of Service: https://www.efruitmandi.live/terms-of-service
- Payment Escrow Policy: https://www.efruitmandi.live/payment-escrow-policy
- KYC Verification Policy: https://www.efruitmandi.live/kyc-verification-policy
- OG Verified Policy: https://www.efruitmandi.live/og-verified-policy
- Commission and Fee Policy: https://www.efruitmandi.live/commission-fee-policy
- Shipping and Logistics Policy: https://www.efruitmandi.live/shipping-logistics-policy
- Sitemap: https://www.efruitmandi.live/sitemap.xml

## Platform Summary

eFruitMandi helps growers list fruit lots and receive quotations from verified buyers. Buyers can discover fruit lots, submit quotes, and complete payments through a secure platform flow. Logistics partners can participate in fruit transportation after registration and KYC verification.

## Main Fruit Categories

Apple, Pear, Plum, Persimmon, Cherry, Peach, Mango, Almond.
